summary_en: Introduces NAS-GS, a sonar-specific Gaussian Splatting framework for 3D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis. Two-Ways Splatting models the distinct sonar intensity-accumulation and transmittance directions, while a Gaussian-mixture noise model represents sidelobes, speckle, and multipath so that scene Gaussians do not overfit measurement noise. The method is evaluated on both simulated scenes and real offshore sonar data.
